tests.note: The 20,000 generated cases are inside one test, not 20,000 additional test runner cases.

scopeNotes: Browser tests run actual Chromium pointer/click/keyboard input on browser fixtures. Pen signals are synthetic. Touch is browser emulation, not physical hardware.
Direct browser navigation to file and loopback URLs is blocked by the environment. Original demo assets and standalone exported HTML were exercised as browser fixtures.
No clean registry install, Firefox/WebKit run, physical-device test or accessibility certification is claimed.
